reason: Covers all eight numbered mathematical clauses: individual/block/mean unbiasedness, product-law block independence, individual/block and centered bounds, exact variance and rate, Chebyshev consistency, eventually zero Lindeberg numerator and the standard normal CDF limit, the corresponding contrast assertions, both fitted subtraction identities, coefficient consistency, root-block asymptotic equivalence and fitted consistency/normality. B+1 is a harmless reindexing of positive block counts. The finite abstract block law generalizes the four-school hierarchical assignment; omitting the unused upper bound pi<1, allowing nondisjoint paired events, and allowing any finite I with E[I]=pi in the individual identity strengthen the valid mathematics. Coordinatewise covariate bounds are equivalent to bounded norm in fixed dimension. Positive definiteness, all-sample positivity of pHat, the uniform o_p(B^-1/2) error rate and the zero-on-singular convention are explicitly canonical. The unnormalized Lindeberg numerator being zero implies the printed normalized sum is zero, since total variance is strictly positive.
